# Dev.to Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that reads and writes your dev.to account: own profile, own articles (published, drafts, all), public articles by any username, create articles (draft by default), update articles. Publishing goes live immediately — always confirm the exact title and content first; drafts are safe to stage (max 4 tags per article). Uses a dev.to API key (Settings > Account), kept in Muse's secure vault. dev.to is free. Draft: written from dev.to's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
